Senior Mining EngineerShare this job:Location:Eastern Highlands, Eastern Highlands,Papua New GuineaIndustry:Mining, Oil and Gas, Mining, Oil and GasJob ID:#24738Date Posted:13th October 2025Source:www.pngworkforce.comJob Type:PermanentAbout usK92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.About the roleIn this role you will assist the Mining Manager and Superintendents to provide medium, long term and /or strategic mine planning including underground mining optimization, design, production scheduling, cost estimations, underground expansion studies, administration of the computerized dispatch system, short term production and capital projects and to supervise, mentor and develop graduate mining engineers.Key AccountabilitiesComplete to the required standards, all medium, long term and/or strategic mine planning activities for underground mine incline operations, including production scheduling, reconciliation, reporting, portal optimization, design, cost estimations, along with conduct of meetings, and supervision, development and mentoring of mine planning and projects graduate.Oversee the operation of the dispatch system to identify trends, problems, inefficiencies, or non-compliance with operating procedures, taking action or making recommendations for continuous improvement through reports and weekly system improvement meetings.Ensure all aspects of mining operations design and planning comply with Company policy and statutory requirements including health and safety, environment, and agreement with landowners.Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.About YouTo be considered for this role it is essential that you must have a bachelor’s degree in mining engineering and must have mining operational experience with 5 years of technical experience in a similar role. In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.Experience in mining engineering, preferably in an underground environment, with sound exposure to production activities including production planning.Strong computer skills with mine design (Surpac) and scheduling programs.Sound knowledge of safe mining practices and standards in an underground Narrow Vein Mine.Good written and verbal communication skills as well as good organizational and administrative skills.Life at K92K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIPApplyEmail job to a friendYour name:Your email:Your friend's name:Your friend's email:COMPANY INFOK92 Mining Inc.K92 Mining Inc.
